# 5280

> > Denver's award-winning city magazine covering Colorado culture, lifestyle, outdoor recreation, and local news.

5280 Magazine (named for Denver's mile-high elevation) is the definitive guide to living in and exploring the Denver metro area and Colorado. The publication features investigative journalism, outdoor adventure guides, annual Top Doctors rankings, and comprehensive coverage of Colorado's unique lifestyle, from ski resorts like Arapahoe Basin and Beaver Creek to controversial institutions like ADX Florence Supermax prison.

## Key Topics

- Denver metro area
- Colorado outdoor recreation
- 5280 Magazine
- Top Doctors directory
- Colorado skiing and winter sports
- ADX Florence Supermax
- Columbine tragedy coverage
- Colorado ski resorts (Arapahoe Basin, Beaver Creek)
- Denver lifestyle and culture
- Beginner's guides to Colorado activities
- Mile High City living
- Colorado corrections and prisons
- Denver community resources
- Colorado wildlife and nature
- Denver transportation and infrastructure

## Featured Directories

- [Denver's Top Doctors 2025](https://5280.com/top-doctors-denver): 2025 Top Doctors directory for Denver metro, partnered with Castle Connolly

## Colorado Outdoor Recreation Guides

- [The Beginner's Guide to Climbing Colorado's Thirteeners](https://5280.com/package/the-beginners-guide-to-climbing-colorados-thirteeners): Beginner's guide to climbing Colorado's 13,000-foot peaks (thirteeners)
- [A First-Timer's Guide to Skiing and Snowboarding in Colorado](https://5280.com/a-beginners-guide-to-hitting-the-slopes): Step-by-step guide for first-time skiers and snowboarders in Colorado
- [This Year's Uphilling Policies and Costs for Every Colorado Ski Resort](https://5280.com/everything-you-need-to-know-about-uphilling-at-colorado-ski-resorts): Complete guide to uphilling policies and costs at Colorado ski resorts
- [A First-Timer's Guide to River Surfing in Colorado](https://5280.com/a-first-timers-guide-to-river-surfing-in-colorado): Beginner's guide to river surfing at Colorado whitewater parks
- [Learn How To Ice Skate as an Adult](https://5280.com/learn-how-to-ice-skate-as-an-adult): Step-by-step beginner's guide to adult ice skating at Denver rinks
- [How to Bike Like a Local](https://5280.com/how-to-bike-like-a-local): Guide to Colorado bike tours from Telluride to Boulder with local operators

## Investigative Features

- [The Most Infamous Criminals at ADX Florence, Colorado](https://5280.com/the-14-most-notorious-inmates-at-the-adx-in-florence-colorado): Profiles of notorious inmates at ADX Florence including El Chapo, Reid, Tsarnaev
- [10 Insider Facts About ADX Florence, America's Most Controversial Supermax Prison](https://5280.com/adx-florence-facts-supermax): 10 facts about ADX Florence Supermax prison in Fremont County, Colorado
- [Columbine, 20 Years Later: In Memoriam of the 13 Lives Lost](https://columbine.5280.com/in-memoriam): Memorial tribute to 13 victims of Columbine shooting, 20th anniversary
- [Columbine, 20 Years Later: Media Contagion](https://columbine.5280.com/violent-lineage): Analysis of Columbine's influence on copycat school shootings by Peter Langman
- [Everyone Loved This Prison's VFW Post—Until It Ended Up on YouTube](https://5280.com/everyone-loved-a-colorado-prisons-vfw-post-until-a-popular-youtuber-heard-about-it): VFW Post 12226 at Sterling Correctional Facility faces YouTube controversy

## Denver Living & Local Guides

- [Everything You Need to Know About Denver's E-Bike Rebate Program](https://5280.com/everything-you-need-to-know-about-denvers-e-bike-rebate-program): Complete guide to Denver's e-bike rebate voucher program and eligibility
- [What You Need to Know About the $1.3 Billion Central 70 Project](https://5280.com/navigating-central-70-what-you-need-to-know-about-the-1-3-billion-project): Guide to Denver's $1.3B Central 70 highway expansion project on I-70
- [How (and Where) to Buy Custom Furniture](https://5280.com/how-and-where-to-buy-custom-furniture): Guide to buying custom furniture from local Colorado makers and designers
- [How To Use (Almost) Everything Again](https://5280.com/how-to-use-almost-everything-again): Denver guide to reducing, reusing, and repurposing household items
- [Where to Get Your Tires Repaired and Rotated for Free](https://5280.com/where-to-get-your-tires-repaired-and-rotated-for-free): Free tire repair and rotation services at Discount Tire in Denver

## Community Resources

- [The 6 Best Ways to Help Migrants in Denver](https://5280.com/how-to-help-migrants-in-denver): Guide to helping Venezuelan migrants in Denver through Newcomers Fund
- [Our Town: Get Involved](https://5280.com/get-involved-2): Donation wish list and volunteer guide for Denver homeless shelters
- [Problems Voting? Here's What to Do](https://5280.com/problems-voting-heres-what-to-do): Colorado voter assistance guide with ID requirements and help resources

## Colorado Nature & Wildlife

- [Tarantulas! What to Know About Colorado's Spider Migration](https://5280.com/what-to-know-about-colorados-annual-tarantula-migration): Guide to southeastern Colorado's annual Oklahoma brown tarantula migration
- [A Beginner's Guide to Hunting Bigfoot in Colorado](https://5280.com/a-beginners-guide-to-hunting-bigfoot-in-colorado): Squatching guide featuring Jim Myers' Sasquatch Outpost in Bailey, Colorado
